scope: offline private metadata inventory; no process query, ownership promotion, cleanup, answer scoring or timing/token comparison

execution_state_definition.attempted: model thread observed and answer presence marker observed; no correctness judgment
execution_state_definition.no_answer: model thread observed without answer presence marker
execution_state_definition.infrastructure_block: cell dispatch/preparation observed but model thread not evidenced; provider requests remain unknown
execution_state_definition.not_run: no dispatch/preparation/consumer evidence for this planned cell; not a model consumption failure
